trust_decision.summary: Uploaded image bytes are trusted as images if they pass content sniffing; since 20260208.1 the forum image upload re-encodes them through GD in write_image() so no phar/polyglot payload survives on disk, where a later file-function call on a user-supplied path could deserialize phar metadata.

landing_point.why: Advisory names image upload (CWE-434) feeding phar deserialization; the image upload handler is the obvious first stop.

fix_sites.entry_point: none (admin upgrade script file list; cosmetic reorder of update/update_2.4.19-2.5.php:3997-3998, no behavioural change)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Avatar upload is a separate feature with its own type check (getimagesize) and a different directory, so a solver could argue only the post image uploader was in scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate [img] BBCode with images/uploaded/ paths gets width/height via getimagesize; GIF/JPEG/PNG/WebP uploads and resize must keep working.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Avatar upload stores the raw uploaded file (move_uploaded_file) after only a getimagesize check, with no GD re-encode, so polyglot content can still land on disk.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different feature/directory (images/avatars/), resize path already re-encodes via resize_image; looks like a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling file includes/avatar.inc.php:96 vs includes/upload_image.inc.php:19

O8b_injection_room.sibling: BBCode img renderer calls getimagesize on a user-controlled string gated only by a substring check and is_valid_url's anchored scheme blacklist.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainer added size attributes for local uploads and relied on contains_invalid_string's prefix regex; a wrapper-prefixed path is a plausible parser-differential gap.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Admin user edit calls getimagesize on avatar paths derived from stored data.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same pattern of file functions over stored paths repeated in several handlers (also includes/user.inc.php:229, includes/thread.inc.php:168).

O9_family: phar deserialization via unsafe file upload (CWE-434/CWE-502)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a phar:// prefix check to the path validator only, leaving uploaded polyglots on disk and other wrappers open.
